Taiwo Okeowo
Research Interests

Resilient systems, human-centric design.

My research explores the intersection of network systems, blockchain, and human-centric design to achieve resilience and integrity in distributed communication infrastructures. I'm interested in adaptive QoS, edge-assisted XR networks, and secure integration for immersive environments — alongside networking, distributed systems, mobile computing, security and privacy, identity science, and software computing.
